user.description: Add a PurpleAir sensor near Home Assistant, or enter a sensor ID.

nearby.description: Search for PurpleAir sensors near a location. Distances are in miles.

data_description.latitude: Starts at the Home Assistant location.
data_description.longitude: Starts at the Home Assistant location.
data_description.radius_miles: Sensors farther than this are hidden. The default is 5 miles, and the maximum is 25.

pick.description: Choose a sensor. The label shows the sensor ID, the distance in miles, and the current PM2.5 when AirFire has one.

by_id.description: Enter the numeric PurpleAir sensor ID from the AirNow Fire and Smoke Map.

data_description.name: Optional. Leave blank to use Purple Air and the sensor ID.

error.sensor_not_found: AirFire has no data for that sensor ID.
error.invalid_data: AirFire returned data that could not be read.
error.no_nearby_sensors: No unconfigured sensors are within that radius. Widen the search or change the location.

abort.already_configured: This PurpleAir sensor is already configured.
